baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired أظلم/الظالمين encloses افترى على الله الكذب.
baseline_models.mechanism: Falsehood is manufactured by cutting and joining, but the craft lands as destructive misplacement and withholding. The verse therefore diagnoses an edited attribution that occupies God's place and blocks what is due to truth, not a stray factual error.

activation_trace.role: Concrete misplacement makes ظلم the diagnosis of putting an attribution in the wrong place.
Withholding a due right makes the fabrication obstruct rightful attribution and access to truth.
Cutting for repair or stitching supplies the craft by which a false account can be assembled.
Destructive splitting supplies the damaging result of the same editorial operation.
Opposition to truth identifies the material being manufactured as falsehood.

changed_reading.before: Someone tells an especially grave lie about God.
changed_reading.after: Someone cuts and stitches a false attribution into God's place, thereby misplacing and withholding truth while a corrective summons is live.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The active fabrication against God occurs while the subject is passively يُدْعَى إلى الإسلام.
baseline_models.mechanism: The call can draw near, but the same root inventory also carries claiming a right or affiliation. Islam simultaneously offers soundness, reconciliation, and handing-over. The scene can therefore hold a jurisdictional contest: at the summons to relinquish self-authored control, the subject asserts a rival claim and assigns it to the worshipped One.

activation_trace.role: Calling by speech supplies the live invitation that draws the addressee near.
Claiming a right or affiliation lets the same call-word expose a competing assertion of authority.
Soundness and freedom from defect name one possible destination of the summons.
Reconciliation supplies a social destination distinct from mere doctrinal assent.
Handing over and letting go make surrender of control a live component of the invitation.
Worship and the worshipped One identify whose authority the rival attribution appropriates.

changed_reading.before: The liar rejects an invitation to a named religion.
changed_reading.after: At a summons toward soundness, peace, and handing-over, the liar answers with a rival claim of affiliation or authority and falsely assigns it to the One worshipped.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وهو يدعى precedes والله لا يهدي within the same sentence.
baseline_models.mechanism: A call that already draws toward a destination precedes the denial of hidaya. Guidance can be gentle indication and also a sustained course or bearing; ظلم can prevent access to a right. The final clause thus lands after direction has become available and marks failure of passage from summons into an upright course.

activation_trace.role: The spoken call establishes that an orienting signal is already present.
Gentle indication toward a way distinguishes guidance from mere exposure to a call.
Course, manner, and intended direction extend guidance into sustained orientation.
Prevention and withholding explain how the act itself can obstruct transition into the offered course.
Uprightness supplies the collective posture that successful orientation would produce.

changed_reading.before: God simply withholds information or guidance from wrongdoers.
changed_reading.after: The call is already audible, but the fabricated misplacement blocks its conversion into a gently conducted, upright course; the divine non-guidance closes that failed passage.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The singular fabricator is finally classified within القوم الظالمين.
baseline_models.mechanism: Qawm may be a human group, but its inventory also supplies standing, uprightness, and stoppage. The verse moves from one act to a collective posture: repeated misplacement can constitute a people as those who stand against rectification or become motionless on the offered way, without requiring an immutable ethnic identity.

activation_trace.role: The ordinary human group supplies the social scale of the closing classification.
Uprightness makes group identity readable as a maintained posture toward a way.
Stoppage and exhaustion preserve the competing image of a body that no longer advances.
Repeated misplacement supplies the practice by which the collective posture is formed.

changed_reading.before: The closing phrase labels a fixed population of wrongdoers.
changed_reading.after: The closing phrase can classify a response-formed social body: people whose repeated misplacement becomes an obstructive standing or a stalled posture on the offered route.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening context supplies comprehensive exonerating praise and exact construction. Against that field, the focus lie reads as anomalous counter-testimony inserted into a world whose encompassing witness already clears God of the attribution.

activation_trace.role: Exoneration and clearing supply the positive testimony against which the false attribution sounds.
Exactness and secure construction make the surrounding order resistant to the fabricated splice.
Falsehood against truth anchors the contextual contrast in the focus noun.

structural_cues: 61:1 places the whole heavenly and earthly field in one praising action before 61:7.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies total praise, exoneration, and exactness; I infer that they function as an evidentiary backdrop to 61:7. A live alternative is that 61:1 is ritual praise without testimonial force.

changed_reading.before: The false attribution is a private speaker's isolated offense.
changed_reading.after: The attribution is a discordant counter-witness inserted against a comprehensive field already exonerating God, which heightens both its isolation and its manufactured character.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated gap between saying and doing turns الكذب from false content alone into failed enactment. A charge can prove true by being carried through or false by failing; the focus fabrication is therefore also speech that refuses embodiment while the call demands a response.

activation_trace.role: Saying what is not supplies the context's explicit mismatch at the level of speech.
Producing an act supplies the missing realization against which speech is tested.
Intense aversion to ugliness raises the speech-act breach from inconsistency to a grave relational offense.
A charge fulfilled or failed lets الكذب register whether a declared commitment survives performance.

structural_cues: 61:2 and 61:3 repeat تقولون/تقولوا ما لا تفعلون, making nonperformance a framing problem before 61:7.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated speech without action and a branch where a charge becomes false by failing; I infer that the invitation in 61:7 calls for enactment, not assent alone. The alternative is that the earlier rebuke and the later fabrication address separate faults.

changed_reading.before: The lie is a false theological sentence.
changed_reading.after: The lie is also a failed performance: speech appropriates divine authority while the speaker's response never crosses into the act of surrender requested by the live call.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context's straight alignment, joined construction, and packed firmness activate the constructive and destructive sides of فري. A truthful collective is assembled by fitting parts into relation; the falsehood is a rival construction that cuts and rejoins discourse but cannot produce sound alignment.

activation_trace.role: Alignment on an even line supplies coordinated placement as the context's first construction rule.
Building by joining parts supplies the coherent assembly against which fabrication is measured.
Packing and securing parts supplies structural firmness rather than a merely attractive surface.
Cutting to stitch makes the focus fabrication a competing act of assembly.
Destructive splitting explains why the rival assembly damages rather than integrates.

structural_cues: 61:4 compresses row, building, and compactedness into one ordered material simile.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two assembly modes: aligned joining in 61:4 and cutting or stitching in the focus inventory; I infer a contrast between coherent and counterfeit construction. The alternative is that the military building image has no discourse-level extension.

changed_reading.after: Fabrication counter-builds: it edits and joins pieces into a rival structure, whereas the offered way asks parts and persons to enter a firm, correctly aligned whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding causal sequence begins with their deviation, then gives a divine causing-to-deviate of hearts, then denies guidance. Its closing formula recurs in 61:7. This converts the focus ending from an isolated verdict into the second phase of a feedback process initiated by the fabricating response.

activation_trace.role: Departure from straightness supplies both the initiating motion and its causative return.
Turning a thing from its face supplies the interior reversal that follows outward deviation.
Gentle indication toward the way anchors the repeated denial of guidance in a path mechanism.
Misplacement identifies the focus fabrication as a candidate first deviation in the repeated sequence.

structural_cues: 61:5 explicitly orders initial deviation, caused heart-deviation, and no guidance; 61:7 repeats the final والله لا يهدي القوم construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the causal arrow in 61:5; I infer that 61:7's fabrication occupies the initiating slot of the analogous sequence. A live alternative is that the repeated ending is only a classification and imports no temporal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: No guidance is a standalone divine refusal after a lie.
changed_reading.after: The lie is a self-initiated displacement that enters a feedback loop: outward deviation is followed by inward reorientation away from the path, and the repeated no-guidance clause names that resulting condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clear signs arrive, yet the audience verbally recodes them as manifest magic. The focus lie can therefore be produced not only by invention from nothing but by reversing the public label on disclosed evidence until clarity is treated as deception.

activation_trace.role: Appearance and disclosure make the evidence publicly available before it is relabeled.
Turning and deception supply the audience's counter-description of what was disclosed.
Saying what is not supplies the verbal operation by which the counter-label is imposed.
Declaring a report or bearer false anchors the focus lie as active misclassification.

structural_cues: 61:6 sequences arrival with clear signs and the immediate spoken verdict هذا سحر مبين.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure followed by a deceptive counter-label; I infer that this is one concrete mode of fabricating against God in 61:7. The alternative is that 61:7 concerns a different newly invented claim rather than denial of the signs.

changed_reading.before: To fabricate is to originate a proposition with no basis.
changed_reading.after: To fabricate can also be to seize disclosed evidence and reverse its public classification, calling clarity deception and thereby making a lie out of the act of labeling.

context_deltas.mechanism: The messenger confirms what is before him and announces one coming after him, creating a before-present-after chain. The focus cutting and stitching can now be heard as an illicit splice in that transmission: it severs sequence or reconnects its segments under a false divine attribution.

activation_trace.role: Succession and discrete segments supply the structure of a transmitted sequence.
Fulfilling a promise or deed makes confirmation the faithful preservation of a prior commitment.
After in relation to before fixes the temporal ordering that an illicit splice would disturb.
Cutting for stitching supplies the technical image of editing and reconnecting a chain.
Destructive splitting supplies the possibility that the edit severs continuity.

structural_cues: 61:6 explicitly links confirmation of what is before with annunciation of a messenger after.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal continuity and the focus supplies cutting or stitching; I infer the directional arrow from false attribution to damaged transmission. The alternative is ordinary chronology with no editorial metaphor.

changed_reading.before: The liar makes a detached false claim about God.
changed_reading.after: The liar performs an unauthorized splice in a transmitted sequence, cutting or rejoining the before-present-after relation under a counterfeit divine authorization.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah materializes hostile speech as an intended attempt to cool a flame with mouths, while divine light moves toward completion. This gives the focus fabrication a causal aim: the mouth-made attribution tries to disable the very medium by which the call can orient, but the completion clause denies that the attempt controls the outcome.

activation_trace.role: Intention and volition make extinction an aimed effect rather than an accidental consequence.
A flame becoming still and embers cooling supply the attempted material effect.
Illumination supplies the orienting medium that hostile speech tries to suppress.
Opening the mouth in speech identifies verbal production as the instrument of attempted extinction.
Arrival at completion blocks the inference that hostile speech can terminate the light.
False speech anchors the mouth-based attempt back in the focus act.

structural_cues: 61:8 directly follows 61:7 and orders hostile intention, mouth-action, light, and assured completion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intention, verbal instrument, attempted cooling, and completion; I infer that the fabrication in 61:7 is one mouth-made extinguishing act. The alternative is that 61:8 widens to opponents whose actions exceed the focus liar.

changed_reading.before: The lie corrupts belief but has no specified mechanism or aim.
changed_reading.after: The lie is an attempted verbal technology of extinction: it tries to cool the orienting light at its source, yet the following completion prevents that attempted cause from governing the result.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance arrives with a true din that is to become manifest over every din. The focus claim/affiliation branch now becomes explicitly normative: fabrication against God appropriates authorization for a rival order of obedience and tries to occupy the public position belonging to truth.

activation_trace.role: Course and intended direction make guidance the bearing of an order, not information alone.
Obedience and submission supply the normative regime over which rival claims compete.
Binding right and obligation identify the authorization properly attached to the true order.
Emergence into visibility makes the contest public rather than inward only.
Claiming a right or affiliation anchors the rival authorization in the focus call-word.

structural_cues: 61:9 joins messenger, guidance, true din, and public manifestation over every din.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an order of obedience with binding truth and public manifestation; I infer that the lie in 61:7 attempts rival authorization. The alternative is a narrower doctrinal falsehood with no jurisdictional mechanism.

changed_reading.after: The lie usurps God's authorization for a rival claim about what deserves obedience, attempting to install that claim where the true guiding order is to become manifest.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory includes salam as an advance-payment sale. The later sequence explicitly offers trade, names present exertion with wealth and selves, and promises later deliverance, forgiveness, gardens, and success. Islam can therefore carry a transactional time-structure in which present handing-over precedes a trusted return; fabrication substitutes a counterfeit contract or refuses the creditworthiness of the divine promise.

activation_trace.role: Trade and pursuit of gain make the contextual analogy explicit.
Deliverance by separation names the promised gain of the offered transaction.
Exerting full capacity under hardship supplies present performance rather than verbal assent alone.
Possessed wealth supplies one present asset placed into the exchange.
The thing or self itself supplies the second and more total present stake.
Attaining good and escape supplies the deferred successful return.
Advance-payment sale provides the surprising lexical bridge from al-Islam to the trade sequence.

structural_cues: 61:10 asks about a saving trade; 61:11 states present commitment with wealth and selves; 61:12 states deferred return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the trade-cost-return sequence and the focus supplies the salam-sale branch; I infer a shared temporal contract structure. The materially live alternative is that trade is only a broad metaphor and does not reactivate the technical salam sense.

changed_reading.before: The subject is invited to a static religious identity and answers with a lie.
changed_reading.after: The subject may be invited into a forward exchange: hand over present control and resources in trust of a deferred saving return; fabrication acts like a counterfeit contract or a denial of the promisor's credit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus ظلم inventory can voice a grievance seeking redress. Later, aid includes vindication of the wronged and opening includes judgment that resolves closure. The rhetorical accusation ومن أظلم can therefore be carried not only as classification but as a complaint placed into an approaching process of redress.

activation_trace.role: Vindication of the wronged supplies the social answer to a grievance.
Opening through judgment supplies a process that can resolve the complaint.
Grievance and seeking redress anchor the forensic-affective reading in both ظلم occurrences.

structural_cues: 61:13 follows the accusations with promised aid and a near opening.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies grievance, vindication, and judgment-opening; I infer movement from complaint to redress. The alternative is that the promised aid is collective victory without a forensic relation to 61:7.

changed_reading.before: ومن أظلم is only a superlative moral label.
changed_reading.after: ومن أظلم can also sound like a grievance formally lodged: false divine attribution creates a claim for redress whose answering vindication and opening are anticipated later.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final context stages a call, an answering declaration of help, a split into two factions, support, and public emergence. This activates the focus qawm as a collective formed by response rather than inherited essence: the same summons differentiates helpers from obstructers and gives each group a maintained social posture.

activation_trace.role: Aid that makes another manifest supplies the enacted answer to the call.
A gathered faction supplies the bounded social units produced by divergent responses.
Confirming strength supplies the reinforcement by which one response becomes durable.
Ascendancy and prevailing make the response-formed alignment publicly effective.
The human group anchors the later factional mechanism in القوم.
Uprightness makes the collective's identity a practiced alignment rather than a bare label.

structural_cues: 61:14 orders summons, verbal answer, factional split, reinforcement, and visible outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divergent responses and resulting factions; I infer that the qawm of 61:7 is likewise behaviorally constituted by response to its summons. The alternative is that qawm remains an ordinary preexisting people-term.

changed_reading.before: The wrongdoer belongs to an already fixed group called the unjust people.
changed_reading.after: The summons itself helps form the group: fabrication is one response that consolidates an obstructive collective posture, while answered aid forms a competing aligned body.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it combines the non-dominant ف ت ر mapping under ف ر ي, the non-dominant د ع ع mapping under د ع و, and a peripheral motion sense of كذب. It remains anchored to focus words 4, 7, 9, and 14 and yields a coherent call-to-course sequence; downstream prose should present it only as a kinetic analogy, never as the direct lexical gloss of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: افترى, الكذب, يدعى, and يهدي form a possible interrupted-motion chain inside 61:7.

activation_trace.role: Slackening after intensity supplies loss of momentum after an approach has begun.
Twisting slow movement makes the response to the summons kinetically labored.
An animal running and then stopping to look back supplies arrested advance.
Supported, swaying walking supplies the live possibility of movement that cannot continue unaided.

changed_reading.before: The subject is statically outside guidance.
changed_reading.after: A movement toward soundness may already have begun under the call, then slackens, twists, and stops to look back; fabrication images arrested uptake rather than motion never attempted.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because sheen, thick covering, and patterned cloth are peripheral concrete branches, while the magic and light cues only sharpen their contrast. It remains anchored to all three focus roots and explains how falsehood can look persuasive; render it as a surface metaphor for deceptive appearance, not an etymological definition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أظلم, افترى, and الكذب can jointly support a bright but concealing manufactured surface.

activation_trace.role: A watery dental sheen supplies an attractive flash on the surface of ظلم.
A thick covering supplies the fabricated layer that can hide what lies beneath.
A patterned cloth that deceives by its condition supplies persuasive but unreliable appearance.
Turning and deception reinforce the possibility that public appearance is deliberately recoded.
True illumination supplies the contrast that exposes borrowed sheen as counterfeit.

changed_reading.before: The lie is invisible propositional error.
changed_reading.after: The lie can function as a glossy patterned cover: fabricated appearance flashes as if sound while concealing the destructive cut beneath it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The riddle-like branch of د ع و is peripheral, so this is not a claim that يدعى literally means being riddled. It remains anchored to the passive call and الكذب, and 61:14 supplies an explicit call-and-answer scene; downstream prose may retain it as an answer-demand analogy qualified by that distance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The passive summons in يدعى receives fabrication rather than a disclosed answer.

activation_trace.role: A riddle-like prompt supplies a call designed to draw a hidden answer into speech.
Declaring falsely supplies the substitute answer produced at the moment of summons.
Handing over supplies the truthful answer-act that the fabricated response avoids.
Spoken calling and reply make the later answer scene explicit.
Enacted aid shows what a truthful answer to a summons can become.

changed_reading.before: The invitation merely offers information that can be accepted or rejected.
changed_reading.after: The invitation can be heard as drawing an answer out of the addressee; instead of handing over a truthful allegiance, the fabricator supplies a counterfeit answer in God's name.

strongest_changes: The repeated 61:5 causal sequence turns no-guidance from an isolated verdict into feedback after initiated deviation.
61:8 materializes fabrication as a mouth-driven extinguishing attempt whose intended effect is denied by completion.
61:10-12 unexpectedly aligns the focus salam-sale branch with a present-cost, deferred-return trade structure.
61:14 recasts القوم as a collective posture formed by divergent answers to a summons.
summary.what_was_special: The bookended ظلم, active fabrication inside a passive summons, and the call/no-guidance sequence supported several coexisting mechanisms: editorial damage, rival authorization, failed performance, causal feedback, material extinction, advance exchange, grievance, and response-formed collectivity. The split-root and concrete-surface branches added live but contained kinetic and visual readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The claim-and-affiliation branch of دعو may reveal jurisdictional pressure, or the passive form may carry only ordinary invitation here.
The advance-sale activation is structurally exact across 61:10-12 but may be a contextual resonance rather than a technical sense of الإسلام.
The non-dominant ف ت ر and د ع ع mappings and the concrete sheen/cloth images should remain exploratory analogies, not lexical glosses.
The grievance-to-vindication model may be genuinely forensic, or later aid may remain collective without resolving the focus complaint.
